en: The front side of the postcard shows a historical black-and-white photograph of a pavilion or ornate gazebo surrounded by trees. Many people, men and women dressed in early 20th-century European clothing, are gathered around and beneath the structure, which is festooned with hanging plants and lamps. The bottom of the image has the printed words 'Bad Pyrmont Hauptbrunnen.' The reverse side of the postcard is laid out for address and message, features German text, a museum stamp, and the handwritten year '1905.'
